description: This file defines the SocketReceiver class, which handles receiving data asynchronously over a socket connection using pipes and awaitable event args. It extends a base class and provides methods to wait for data and perform asynchronous receives.

classes.name: SocketReceiver
classes.description: Handles asynchronous socket data reception, extending SocketSenderReceiverBase with methods for waiting for data and receiving data asynchronously.

methods.name: WaitForDataAsync
methods.description: Prepares the awaitable event args and initiates an asynchronous receive operation, returning the event args which can be awaited.

methods.name: ReceiveAsync
methods.description: Sets the buffer for receiving data and starts an asynchronous receive operation, returning the awaitable event args.
